title: Create complex test fixtures for flow visualization
description:
Create comprehensive test issue fixtures in tests/workflows/ to validate flow visualization with various graph patterns:

Patterns needed:
- Diamond: A→B, A→C, B→D, C→D (converging paths)
- Tree (fan-out): A→B, A→C, A→D (multiple dependents)
- Tree (fan-in): A→D, B→D, C→D (multiple dependencies)
- Chain: A→B→C→D→E (linear)
- Disconnected components: multiple separate chains
- Mixed: combination of above patterns

Create in: tests/workflows/flow-patterns.in/.pebbles/issues/

This will enable thorough testing of layout algorithm correctness.
